resources.string: Clock
The clock icon opens the stopwatch, timer, intervals, Tabata, EMOM and more. It is also in the active session.
Favorites
Star exercises in their detail. They come first in the list and when you pick an exercise, and Filters can show favorites only.
Add it to or remove it from favorites; the change reaches your other devices.
Athlete profile
Your body data, experience, goal, availability and health. They are used to suggest a program and you can edit them anytime.
Sync
Shows the changes waiting to be sent and the last sync. Everything is saved on the phone first; "Sync now" retries right away.
Learn
Glossary with RPE, RIR, 1RM, deload and other terms. Underlined terms in these sheets open it too.
The clock icon in the header opens it without leaving the session. "Clock for this exercise" opens it with the exercise name, and stopwatch laps are saved in the session notes.
Five optional steps
Body, experience, goal and availability, health and starting point. Save or skip each step; you can edit everything later in Profile.
Health history
Only with your consent. If you report a condition, we recommend seeing a professional and you can open the official PAR-Q+. It is not a diagnosis.
Suggested program
A catalog template chosen from your days, goal and equipment. It is never added without your confirmation.
Modes and profiles
Pick a mode or a routine, adjust times and rounds, and save it as a profile. Sequences accept timed phases or rep phases that end with "Done".
With the app closed
The clock keeps running in the background with its notification: pause, add 15 s, skip or mark a lap. It warns 10 s before a rest ends and recovers if you restart the phone.
Signals and hands-free control
Color, vibration, sound and voice for each phase, or vibration only. Volume up pauses; volume down marks a lap or skips. You can turn on voice control and pause on calls.
More tools
Multi timer, metronome, holds with records, field tests, large time of day, countdown to a date and lap history with CSV export.
Sharing and shortcuts
Share a profile by file or QR. Long press the app icon, use the quick settings tile or the widget to open the clock at once.
How to read it
Each card explains a term the app uses. Come back here when you see an underlined term in "How to use".
